source.documentTitle: R-Series Next-Gen MiniCon 1/2 to 6 HP Air-Cooled Condensing Units

commonFeatures.detail: Russell states an average 3 to 5 F of subcooling.

commonFeatures.feature: High-efficiency condenser with enhanced copper tubes and aluminum fins
Crankcase heater and fixed-high/adjustable-low pressure control
All-weather galvanized painted housing and receiver with isolation valve
Rated for ambient air temperatures up to 110 F

notes: The published R448A/R449A map is stored here as the R448A selection for the Russell R*O600E4S** unit with Copeland ZS45K4E scroll compressor.
The manual marks a 20 F maximum superheat area in the published R448A/R449A capacity table.
The live suction value must be validated as saturated suction temperature before capacity lookup.
The manual directs multiplying published 60 Hz capacity by 0.83 for 50 Hz operation.
Do not extrapolate outside the published 90-110 F ambient and 45 to -10 F suction-temperature envelope.

powerRatingAvailability.preferredFutureSource: Installed three-phase power meter or Copeland compressor performance data at the operating point.

modelVariants.modelNumberStatus: Base pattern verified from the supplied Russell manual; style, refrigerant, voltage, vintage, and option characters require the installed nameplate.

compressor.lowTemperatureCoolingProvision: Extended-medium-temperature application; no low-temperature injection provision is specified for this unit.

capacityTable.interpolationPolicy: Bilinear interpolation is allowed only between adjacent published ambient and suction-temperature points after confirming the suction input represents saturated suction temperature.
capacityTable.extrapolationPolicy: Never extrapolate beyond the published table envelope.

calculationWarnings: The Russell manual publishes one combined R448A/R449A capacity table; this record is selectable as R448A and must not be relabeled as R404A.
The R404A and R448A capacity maps use different suction-temperature columns and must remain separate catalog records.
RLA and LRA are nameplate reference ratings, not live compressor-current readings or real power.
MCA and MOPD are circuit-sizing references, not normal operating-current targets.
AWEF 7.60 is a manufacturer rating and must not be treated as live efficiency.
Capacity interpolation requires verified condenser entering-air temperature, refrigerant, frequency, and saturated suction temperature.
